## XGrammar Enum Automaton Bug — RE RV=0.03% Root Cause

- 5/17341 violations in phase2_docred_full_s1 (xgrammar 0.1.33)
- All 5 from single doc "Souvlaki", chimeric relation "membericipant of" = token "member" + "icipant" + " of"
- Root cause: xgrammar byte-level enum automaton allows subword tokens from different enum entries to combine
- After "member", xgrammar allows 8 tokens when only " of"-continuing tokens should be valid
- TypeConstraintProcessor (Layer 2) doesn't catch this because RELATION_TYPE is fully delegated to xgrammar (Layer 1)
- Paper wording decision: Option B — "a rare XGrammar automaton bug where subword tokens from different enum entries combine into chimeric values"
- Full analysis: artifacts/r2n10_rv_root_cause.md

## Q1 Zero Violations — Cross-Model Replication

- Llama-3.1-8B LoRA FT + beam k=4 + full_s1 achieves ET=0%, RV=0%, DR=0%, CF=0% on SciERC (551 samples)
- Replicates w10_qwen_scierc_ft_beam_4 results on a second model
- Confirms zero violations is a property of OntoCoDec method, not model-specific
- Enables upgrading Abstract claim from single-model to two-model (D055)
- E_F1=67.94%, R_F1=46.11% (Llama) vs E_F1=62.17%, R_F1=52.35% (Qwen) — F1 trade-offs differ by model but violations identical

## 70B SciERC Results Summary

- 70B AWQ-INT4 (Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct-AWQ-INT4) on SciERC:
  - Unconstrained: ET=7.71%, RV=0.74%, DR=4.72%, E_F1=35.17%
  - Constrained (full_s1): ET=0%, RV=0%, DR=0%, E_F1=35.14%
- OntoCoDec eliminates all structural violations at 70B scale with zero F1 cost
- 70B model has much lower base F1 than 8B FT models (35% vs 62-68%) — expected for zero-shot on specialized IE

## Beam Search Parameter Convention

- Correct CLI: `--decoding_strategy beam --num_beams 4` (NOT `--beam_size 4`)
- Discovered via `--help` on run_constrained_extraction.py
